spring.application.name=urlshort

# Base of every shortUrl; override with URLSHORT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL. Never taken from Host headers.
urlshort.public-base-url=http://localhost:8080

# Per-client rate limit (NFR-R2): /api requests per minute, every other limited request per minute,
# and the proxies whose X-Forwarded-For is believed (exact addresses, comma-separated; none by default).
# Overridable by URLSHORT_RATELIMIT_CREATEPERMINUTE, _REDIRECTPERMINUTE, _TRUSTEDPROXIES.
urlshort.rate-limit.create-per-minute=60
urlshort.rate-limit.redirect-per-minute=600
urlshort.rate-limit.trusted-proxies=
# The audit read trusts only the connection address (ADR-0019); Tomcat must not rewrite it from
# X-Forwarded-For, which Boot otherwise enables on a detected cloud platform.
server.forward-headers-strategy=none

# Operational surface: health probes, metrics and the Prometheus scrape (NFR-R1, NFR-O3, ADR-0016).
management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=health,info,metrics,prometheus
management.endpoint.health.probes.enabled=true
# Readiness is UP only while the database answers; liveness never asks it (business rule 9).
management.endpoint.health.group.readiness.include=readinessState,db
# Status only: the probes are anonymous, details would name the database and its location (AC-15).
management.endpoint.health.show-details=never

# OpenAPI 3 document for the public API.
springdoc.api-docs.path=/v3/api-docs
springdoc.swagger-ui.path=/swagger-ui.html
# Each operation declares its own problem responses; do not derive untyped ones from the error advice.
springdoc.override-with-generic-response=false
# Key-sorted output, so the committed docs/api/openapi.json diffs cleanly (ADR-0010).
springdoc.writer-with-order-by-keys=true
